results.content:
# Amtech Aktie: Wachwechsel an der Spitze  
Veröffentlicht am: 06.08.2026 um 02:59 Uhr | Redaktion boerse-global.de  
Amtech Systems tauscht seinen CEO aus – und legt zeitgleich Zahlen vor, die deutlich über den Erwartungen liegen. Für ein Unternehmen, das sich mitten in einer KI-getriebenen Wachstumsphase befindet, ist das eine ungewöhnliche Kombination: Führungswechsel und Rekordquartal an einem Tag.
## Guy Shechter übernimmt das Ruder  
Der Verwaltungsrat von Amtech hat Guy Shechter zum neuen President und Chief Executive Officer ernannt, wirksam ab dem 13. August 2026. Shechter war erst im Mai 2026 als President und Chief Operating Officer zum Unternehmen gestoßen und bringt Erfahrung aus Führungspositionen bei Yield Engineering Systems und Veeco Instruments mit. Bob Daigle, seit 2023 CEO und zuvor Non-Executive Chairman, wechselt in die neu geschaffene Rolle des Executive Chairman und bleibt damit eng in die Kapitalallokationsstrategie eingebunden, zu der laut Unternehmen auch Übernahmen und Partnerschaften zählen.  
Der Vorstand wächst mit dieser Personalie auf sechs Mitglieder, vier davon gelten nach Nasdaq-Standards als unabhängig. Amtech betont damit ausdrücklich den Ausbau der Corporate Governance.
## Zahlen übertreffen die Erwartungen deutlich  
Parallel zur Personalie meldete Amtech für das dritte Quartal einen Gewinn je Aktie von 0,10 Dollar – drei Cent über der Analystenschätzung von 0,07 Dollar. Der Umsatz kam auf 22,38 Millionen Dollar herein, während der Markt nur mit 20 Millionen Dollar gerechnet hatte. In den vergangenen 90 Tagen gab es eine positive EPS-Revision, keine negative.  
Der Kurs schloss zuletzt bei 16,01 Dollar. Auf Jahressicht steht damit ein Plus von rund 214 Prozent zu Buche, wobei die Aktie in den vergangenen drei Monaten um etwa 25,5 Prozent zurückgekommen ist. Diese Diskrepanz zeigt, wie volatil die Neubewertung des Unternehmens im Zuge der KI-Nachfrage nach Halbleiterpackaging-Lösungen verlaufen ist.  
Mit Shechter an der Spitze und Daigle als Executive Chairman im Hintergrund positioniert sich Amtech für die nächste Wachstumsphase im Geschäft mit KI-Chippackaging und fortschrittlicher Substratfertigung. Der Führungswechsel greift ab dem 13. August 2026 – zu einem Zeitpunkt, an dem das operative Geschäft gerade seine Stärke unter Beweis gestellt hat.  
**Amtech-Aktie: Kaufen oder verkaufen?! Neue Amtech-Analyse vom 6. August liefert die Antwort:**  
Die neusten Amtech-Zahlen sprechen eine klare Sprache: Dringender Handlungsbedarf für Amtech-Aktionäre. Lohnt sich ein Einstieg oder sollten Sie lieber verkaufen? In der aktuellen Gratis-Analyse vom 6. August erfahren Sie was jetzt zu tun ist.

results.name: Amtech Systems (ASYS) Stock News & Updates | StockTitan
results.content:
**Amtech Systems (NASDAQ: ASYS)**, a supplier of equipment and consumables for AI semiconductor device packaging and advanced substrate fabrication, announced that its Board has appointed **Guy Shechter** as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective **August 13, 2026**. Shechter has also been named to the Board of Directors.  
Concurrently, **Bob Daigle**, a director since 2021, Non-Executive Chairman since 2022 and CEO since 2023, will transition to the newly created role of **Executive Chairman of the Board**. Following these changes, Amtech’s Board will have six members, four of whom are independent under Nasdaq standards, which the company says supports its focus on corporate governance and independent oversight.  
According to Amtech, Shechter joined as President and COO in May 2026 and previously held senior leadership roles at Yield Engineering Systems and Veeco Instruments. He holds an MBA and a BSc in Mechanical Engineering from the Technion – Israel Institute of Technology.  
**Amtech Systems (NASDAQ: ASYS)** reported fiscal Q3 2026 net revenue of **$22.4 million**, up **14.5%** year-over-year, driven mainly by its Thermal Processing Solutions (TPS) segment, whose revenue rose **24.9%** to about **$17.7 million**. TPS growth was fueled by strong AI-related advanced packaging and server board assembly equipment demand, with AI-related revenue up approximately **120%** from the prior-year quarter.
**Amtech Systems (NASDAQ: ASYS)** announced its participation in Canaccord Genuity’s 46th Annual Growth Conference, held in-person August 11–13, 2026, at the InterContinental Hotel in Boston, MA. The company will present on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. Eastern time.  
Management will meet with institutional investors on August 11 and 12. The related investor presentation will be available in the investor relations section of Amtech’s website on the mornings of the events and will be webcast for Canaccord Genuity clients.  
**Amtech Systems (NASDAQ: ASYS)**, a maker of equipment and consumables for AI semiconductor packaging and advanced substrate fabrication, is set to join the **Russell 3000** and **Russell 2000** indexes after the US market opens on **June 29, 2026**, based on FTSE Russell’s preliminary additions list.  
Membership in the Russell 3000 for half of 2026 will also bring inclusion in related growth and value style indexes. Amtech’s CEO links this preliminary inclusion, determined before an oversubscribed capital raise in early June, to a successful two-year turnaround and continued profitable growth.  
**Amtech Systems (NASDAQ: ASYS)** closed an oversubscribed underwritten public offering of **2,926,829 shares** of common stock at **$20.50** per share, raising **$60 million** in gross proceeds on June 3, 2026.  
According to Amtech, net proceeds will fund growth initiatives, M&A, working capital and general corporate purposes.
**Amtech Systems (NASDAQ: ASYS)** priced an oversubscribed underwritten public offering of **2,926,829 common shares** at **$20.50 per share**, targeting **\~$60 million** in gross proceeds before fees.  
The offering is expected to close on or about **June 3, 2026**. Proceeds will fund growth initiatives, potential M&A, working capital and general corporate purposes.  
**Amtech Systems (NASDAQ: ASYS)** commenced an underwritten public offering of common stock, subject to market conditions. The size and pricing are not yet set and completion is uncertain.  
Net proceeds are intended to fund growth in semiconductor packaging and wafer substrate platforms, M&A, working capital and general corporate purposes.  
**Amtech Systems (NASDAQ:ASYS)**, a manufacturer of equipment and consumables for AI semiconductor device packaging and advanced substrate fabrication, will participate in two upcoming investor conferences.  
Events include the **B. Riley Securities Institutional Investor Conference** on May 21, 2026, and the **Planet MicroCap Las Vegas 2026 Conference** on June 17–18, 2026.  
**Amtech Systems (NASDAQ: ASYS)** appointed Guy Shechter as President and Chief Operating Officer, effective **May 19, 2026**, reporting to the CEO. The company described the role as newly created to support its AI semiconductor device packaging and advanced substrate fabrication businesses.

results.name: Management Team :: Amtech Systems, Inc. (ASYS)
results.content:
Navigating Innovation: More than a Century of Collective Expertise in Semiconductor, Electronics, and Advanced Materials Defines Our Executive Team  
Chief Executive Officer & Chairman of the Board  
Robert C. Daigle became CEO of Amtech Systems in August 2023, having joined the Board in August 2021 and elected Chairman in March 2022. Prior to his role at Amtech, Mr. Daigle served as Senior Vice President and Chief Technology Officer at Rogers Corporation, where he had a distinguished 30-year career in various senior executive positions. At Rogers, he successfully built and led both the High Frequency Circuit Materials and Power Electronics Solutions businesses. Mr. Daigle holds a B.S. in Chemical Engineering and Materials Engineering from the University of Connecticut and an M.B.A. from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute.  
President and Chief Operating Officer
President and Chief Operating Officer  
Guy A. Shechter joined Amtech Systems in May 2026 as President & Chief Operating Officer, bringing more than 25 years of experience in the semiconductor capital equipment industry, with deep expertise in business development, operations and services. Prior to Amtech, he served as Senior Vice President and General Manager of Yield Engineering Systems (YES), where he was part of the executive leadership team driving significant growth, and led the adoption of key manufacturing steps for advanced packaging next-generation AI technology. Earlier, Mr. Shechter held multiple executive roles at Veeco Instruments Inc. from 2007 to 2020, most recently as Vice President and General Manager, Global Services Solutions, leading a global organization with responsibility for $150 million in revenue. Mr. Shechter holds an MBA and a B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, magna cum laude, from the Technion – Israel Institute of Technology.  
Chief Financial Officer
Chief Financial Officer  
Thomas Sabol joined Amtech in May of 2026 as Chief Financial Officer, bringing more than 30 years of senior financial leadership experience, including over 20 years serving as CFO for both public and private companies. Prior to joining Amtech, Mr. Sabol served as Interim Chief Financial Officer and Head of HR with Korn Ferry Executive Interim Services. Earlier in his career, he held CFO roles at Corcentric, Transact Campus and Rimini Street, where he helped lead the company through its initial public offering. Mr. Sabol also previously served as Chief Financial Officer and later Chief Operating Officer at Plexus Corp., supporting international expansion and acquisitions. He began his career with Coopers & Lybrand and is a Certified Public Accountant holding a B.A. in Accounting from Marquette University.
